$query = "SELECT node.nid AS nid, m.field_merit_reward_value AS merits
FROM {node} node
LEFT JOIN {field_data_field_merit_reward} m ON node.nid = m.entity_id
WHERE node.nid IN (:nids)
AND node.status = 1
AND node.type = 'project'";
$replaced = explode('|',$project_ids);

$resarray = $result->fetchAll();

//watchdog('rule','rules_get_merits_for_projects ' . print_r($resarray,TRUE));

echo json_encode($resarray);

?>
